d:
Bihar ke betiya men shadi ke mahaj derh sal bad dusri shadi ki khabar ne do parivaron ke bich vivad khara kar diya. beti ke sasural pahunche mayke valon ka aarop hai ki un par lathi-dandon aur harve-hathiyar se hamla kiya gaya. marpit men kaee log ghayal hue aur gari ke shishe tor die gae. pulis aavedan ka intjar kar rahi hai.
